description: This file defines the 'EmailSubscriber' entity class for Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_email_subscriber' database table and includes properties for id, name, email, and a relation to an EmailNotification. The class provides getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: EmailSubscriber
classes.description: An entity representing an email subscriber, associated with an email notification, with properties for id, name, email, and the related notification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this email subscriber.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this email subscriber.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subscriber.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the subscriber.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the subscriber.

methods.name: setEmailNotification
methods.description: Associates this subscriber with an EmailNotification entity.
